code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, elevated RDW, monocytosis, and basophilia. Renal function is impaired (elevated creatinine), and chloride is slightly high. Other parameters, including liver function and electrolytes, are within normal limits. Findings suggest possible acute or chronic hypoxic and renal pathology, with hematologic abnormalities that may indicate infection, inflammation, or bone marrow involvement. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
